description: This file defines classes and methods for module quality testing in an OpenERP/Odoo environment, including abstract test class and specific quality check and detail models.

classes.name: abstract_quality_check
classes.description: Abstract class for all quality tests, providing initialization, test execution, and utility methods.

classes.name: module_quality_check
classes.description: Model representing a quality check for a module, capable of running tests and calculating overall score.

classes.name: module_quality_detail
classes.description: Model representing individual test details and results within a quality check.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Abstract method to perform a quality test; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: get_objects
methods.description: Retrieve all object names of a given module.

methods.name: get_model_ids
methods.description: Get IDs of models given their names.

methods.name: get_ids
methods.description: Get record IDs for a list of object models.

methods.name: format_table
methods.description: Format data as a wiki-style table.

methods.name: format_html_table
methods.description: Format data as an HTML table.

methods.name: get_style
methods.description: Return CSS styles for HTML pages.

methods.name: check_quality
methods.description: Calculate and return the overall quality score and details for a module.
